context.transcript:
I have just a couple more things to mention before we end today's meeting.
I know this is already a busy time for all of us nature guides here at Greenwood State Preserve, but with vacation season coming up, we're expecting more visitors.
To accommodate the increase in tourism, we'll be keeping the park open two hours later in the summer.
This means that extra shifts will be available for all park employees, so please let your supervisor know if you're interested in working more hours.
Also, if you lead groups on the hiking trails, remember that the Wildflower Trail is still closed due to renovations on the bridge.
context.transcript_translation:
在结束今天的会议之前，我还有几件事要提到。
我知道我们 Greenwood State Preserve 的所有自然向导现在都很忙，但随着假期季节的到来，我们预计会有更多游客。
为了适应旅游业的增长，夏季我们将把公园开放时间延长两个小时。
这意味着所有公园员工都将有额外的班次可供选择，所以如果您有兴趣增加工作时间，请告知您的主管。
另外，如果您在徒步小径上带领小组，请记住 Wildflower Trail 由于桥梁正在翻修，仍然关闭。
